correctness.rationale: For bidegree (4,3) over F2 the 9 independent rational evaluation constraints on 20 monomials give 2^11-1=2047 nonzero filling forms. Independent differentiation at all nine rational points gave 364 candidates, then independently generated four dehomogenized ideals (f, fx, fy) and checked each Groebner basis over F2 for unit ideal; exactly 66 were geometrically smooth, so geometric genus=(4-1)(3-1)=6. An independently constructed GL2(F2)^2 action partitioned the entire smooth set into four disjoint orbits, representative masks and sizes (396246,6),(399606,18),(404886,36),(420790,6). Independent GF(2^n) arithmetic counted all P1xP1 points for n=1,...,6 on each representative and yielded N-vectors (9,9,9,9,69,51), (9,9,9,21,39,39), (9,9,12,17,24,78), (9,11,9,23,9,53). Newton recurrence and genus-six functional equation determine distinct length-13 Weil coefficient vectors, starting (1,6,20,48,90),(1,6,20,48,93),(1,6,20,49,98),(1,6,21,54,114). Independently encoded Cartier entries as binary coefficient extractions and computed first/stable sixth ranks 6,6,5,6; resulting a-numbers 0,0,1,0, with exactly 36 nonordinary forms and rank floor 5. Unit-ideal test is geometric, not sampling finitely many extensions; zeta polynomial determination uses the proved genus/functional equation, not a purported bound from finite observations.
residual_risks: Counts identify embedded polynomial equations and factor-preserving PGL2(F2)^2 orbits; no classification of abstract isomorphism classes is asserted.
Exact symbolic Gröbner arithmetic assumes standard SymPy algorithm correctness; source checker and independent tests use fully reproducible finite algorithms.

value.rationale: A complete arithmetic genus-six classification at an extremal geometric bidegree, with four explicit rational Jacobian isogeny types and sharp p-rank floor, is a natural unknown geometric invariant. It is neither a mere confirmation of the minimal degree nor a trivial restatement of the known finite embedding orbit count, since point counts and Cartier stability are additional nontrivial computations.
